title: HINGE PILLAR
summary: Sealing at the door hinge pillar (front door post) of the fiberglass body. 52h cement goes between the steel hinge pillar (birdcage), the dash panel and the body hinge pillar, and at the bottom between the steel hinge pillar, the door sill and the door sill extension; 52b sealer goes between the hinge pillar reinforcement and the door sill reinforcement. No parts, only sealing. All models.

fastening.note: Main view: bead of 52h cement along the flanges where the fiberglass body hinge pillar and dash panel meet the steel hinge pillar.

fastening.note: View A (arrow A, from the door opening): 52h cement around the joint at the bottom of the hinge pillar where it meets the door sill and door sill extension, above the underbody.

fastening.to: hinge pillar reinforcement and door sill reinforcement
fastening.note: View B (arrow B): 52b sealer between the hinge pillar reinforcement and the door sill reinforcement at the foot of the hinge pillar.
